step.cmd: Determine if more than one premium reduction code must be entered:

ul.li: If yes, the claim must be processed in MPS. Go to step 7.

step.cmd: In SSO, on the Determination of Earnings screen, input the premium reduction code as follows:

ul.li: If information is displayed in the Wage loss insurance section only, select 2 – WLI in the Premium reduction field.
If information is displayed in the Paid sick leave section only, select 3 – PSL in the Premium reduction field.
If there is information in both the Wage loss insurance and Paid sick leave sections, select 4 - WLI and PSL in the Premium reduction field.

step.cmd: Allocate the monies using the following formula:

ul.li: If the allocation is for one week, allocate the monies for the entire period.

If the allocation is for more than one week, allocate the monies as follows:
Determine the number of paid leave days.
Divide the gross amount received by the number of paid leave days.
Multiply the result by 5 (for each full week).
Multiply the result by the number of days for the last week (if not a full week).

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim being sent to IPOC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on fishing claims or other complex claim conditions or if the claim is already in MPS, select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “2 PRP statuses present on claim.”
Remark line 2: Type “Process cycling CRs and send next paper CR.”

Remarks lines 3–4: Type “PR code [X] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] and PR code [X] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], allocation type [X], amount [$XXX] from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] last week amount [$XXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
